sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: For half and quarter hours Hungarian counts toward the next hour. *Fél tíz* is “half (on the way to) ten”, so it is 9:30: the hour you say is the one after. *Negyed tíz* is 9:15 and *háromnegyed tíz* is 9:45. Leave *óra* out with these: *Fél tíz van.*

English counts from the hour before (“half past nine”), Hungarian toward the hour after. When you hear *fél tíz*, think “not yet ten”. *Negyed óra* is a different thing: “a quarter of an hour”, a length of time, not a time on the clock.
